Sunway Group has received the nod to develop a 20.8 acre plot of land belonging to the Railway Assets Corp (RAC) in the heart of the city, with the project set to transform Seremban into a more vibrant capital.

Transport Minister Anthony Loke Siew Fook said Sunway was selected as the lead developer for the new integrated, mixed-use development known as Seremban Sentral following a competitive request for proposal process carried out by the RAC in May last year.

-Seremban has more than just food — it’s a mix of bustling markets, colourful street art, and iconic eats. I started my day at Pasar Besar Seremban, wandering through noodle stalls, snacks and even the clothing section, before heading out to explore the city’s 6-block-long mural lane. Of course, no trip here is complete without the famous King Bun — but along the way I also tried cendol, seafood, pastries and old-school snacks that make Seremban worth the stop.
